text:
Picture a couple in Scarborough. Quote for new deadlocks in March.

They sit on it. Five weeks.

Week six they book. They call the name they kept seeing on YouTube and Facebook.

(The bloke who quoted first is still waiting.)

Getting found is half the job.

Everyone wants to show up on ChatGPT.

Meanwhile their Google profile says they shut at 4pm on Saturdays. They shut at 1.

AI tools lean on the same basics as Google. Reviews. Correct details. A website that says what you do.

Fix the basics. The robots read them too.

Got ads bringing back AUD$4 for every AUD$1 you spend?

Most owners start fiddling. Swapping images. Chasing new audiences.

Raise the budget.

A machine that pays out four to one gets fed first. Repaint it later.
